mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth industrial expansion regime (INDPRO > 102.5), a decline in industrial production below 102.5 signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 102.5 and INDPRO < 102.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1400 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals recessionary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
